note: Matt 2026-09-10: these catalogs ARE the UX bar, not a parts list. catalogUrls is a FLOOR of five and is append-only — paste a new URL and inventory it; the evaluator option list grows. Fetch the source (shadcn add / registry URL), restyle to navy #102742 / cream #faf8f4 / Geist / Amboqia / Iconoir, and wire the REAL interaction. A cream box with the catalog name is not adapted. The loop is comprehensive: SEO, listing/page information, and UX all rise on the same pass. A missing job is a NEW barrel primitive that still matches the demo.
refuse: npx shadcn add onto app/ or components/site/ — install into components/ui or components/site/v3, then paint with house tokens
npm install beUI / Rare UI / Beautiful UI / Transitions as a second public design system (submodule their demo app, Inter, purple)
Copy their palette, Inter, purple, orbs, magnetic/tilt buttons, or agent-chat chrome onto a listing or place page
Keep the catalog name and throw away the interaction (V3MorphSearch as a labeled cream field is this miss)
Shrink a working full-bleed layout to dodge a 'looks like Zillow' tell
Drop or summarize away PropertySpecs, MLS remarks, schools, payment line items, or Tour/Call/Text
Rewrite Spark listing photos to 320x240 on a card, rail, or hero — 320 is the 88x66 ledger thumb only
Skip a catalog job because the barrel has no primitive yet — ADD the primitive that still matches the demo
Treat a score rise or rebaseline as done when the live control and the demo are not the same interaction

Claim adaptedFrom without the installed file imported by the house primitive (ci:catalog-install). A comment is not an import. motion/react on a house wrapper is a dependency of beUI, not the component.

catalogs.name: Beautiful UI
catalogs.take: Loading, empty, skeleton-to-content, filter chips that reorganize a table, insight cards with a scrubber. Choreography of states, not the agent-chat shell.
catalogs.refuse: Prompt bar, tool chips, approval cards, agent screen, chat panel on a listing or place page.

catalogs.name: beUI
catalogs.take: Tabs with a sliding indicator; expandable control for a grouped ask; action-swap for Tour/Call/Text; bottom sheet; drawer; accordion height; tooltip. Restyle to navy-on-cream, our motion bands, reduced-motion safe.
catalogs.refuse: Tilt cards, docks, magnetic/metallic buttons, shader backgrounds, cylinder carousel, marquee, gooey popover, bounce sidebar.

catalogs.name: Rare UI
catalogs.take: Scroll-progress on a long listing. Nothing else unless the job matches and the motion is in-band.
catalogs.refuse: Fluid orb, matrix orb, gravity letters, gooey nav, emoji reaction, bounce sidebar, GitHub activity, OTP.

catalogs.name: Transitions.dev
catalogs.take: Named recipes at our motion bands: panel reveal, modal open/close, tabs sliding, accordion height, skeleton-to-content, tooltip, image-open (camera only, no 3D glare).
catalogs.refuse: Confetti, gooey plus-menu, 3D tilt, like-button particles, spinning counters as decoration.
